Sends Bearer token in Authorization header

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import scrape, create_engine, CrawlConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(
        auth={"token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.test", "type": "bearer"},
        respect_robots_txt=False,
    )
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await scrape(engine, url)
    print(result.auth_header_sent)
    print(result.status_code)

asyncio.run(main())
```
